name: Calm
desc: Still air, clear nights, safe crossings. Sky-watchers count stars.

name: Rain
desc: A wet year. Harvests and forests grow.

name: East wind
desc: Steady wind to the east. Boats sail faster, and some are blown off course.

name: Omen
desc: A comet or a red moon. The sky-speaker explains what it means.

name: Bless ruler
desc: A sign of favour for a tribe's ruler. Legitimacy rises, unrest falls.

name: Drought
desc: A dry year. Fields fail and people move or raid.

name: Stir revolt
desc: Whisper discontent. Unrest rises and the strongest rival faction grows bold.

name: Storm
desc: Wind and waves. Boats sink, coasts flood.

name: Quake
desc: The ground shakes. Houses and walls fall.

name: Plague
desc: Sickness in one village. It spreads only along contact.

name: Eruption
desc: The island's peak wakes. Fire nearby, ash beyond, rich soil later.
